audit.scope: raw collected files in C:/Users/Mohammed856/finengine-raw-odd (read-only); no network, no data/**, no AWS/Supabase; SHA-256 recomputed for every document listed here (162 files in inventory)
audit.method: The latest annual (FY2025) first, then FY2024, FY2023, FY2022 and every interim from Q1 2023 to H1 2026 (16 filings): statement pages are image-only in all of them, so BS, IS and CF were each rendered and read by eye. Nine 2022 interim/year-end files and one Arabic duplicate were opened on contact sheets (cover, index, review report) and classified without reading statements. The 2008-2021 files (about 100 documents, including annual reports and bilingual FS) were NOT read; they are counted only from inventory metadata. tools/check_transcripts.py (BS identity, cash-flow sum and roll, gross profit before and after bunker subsidy, NI split, quarter sums, cross-filing differences that must be declared) passes for transcripts/4030.json.

value_correctness.summary: SAR thousand. Balance sheet, income statement (revenue, operating costs, gross profit before and after bunker subsidy, operating profit, profit before zakat, profit, parent/NCI split, EPS) and cash flow (CFO, capex, projects under construction, CFI, CFF, net change, opening and closing cash) transcribed from images for FY2022, FY2023, FY2024, FY2025 (audited), FY2025 (unaudited year-end interim, a different document), Q1/H1/9M 2023, 2024, 2025 and Q1/H1 2026, with comparatives (FY2021, 2022 interims). All identities and the 16 quarter-sum chains (revenue and net income) pass. 30 cross-filing differences are declared with BOTH values: (1) EPS restated after bonus issues: FY2022 2.11 vs 1.41, Q1 2023 1.00 vs 0.67, FY2024 2.94 vs 2.35, H1 2024 1.61 vs 1.29, 9M 2024 2.30 vs 1.84, Q1 2025 0.72 vs 0.58; net profit never changes; (2) operating profit 2022-2023 (finance income moved out of operating profit in 2024 filings): FY2022 1,493,290 vs 1,483,147, 9M 2023 1,667,427 vs 1,613,217; (3) operating cash flow re-presented: FY2022 CFO 2,003,760 vs 1,989,531, FY2023 CFO 3,642,919 vs 3,560,560 (CFI -964,801 vs -882,442), Q1 2024 715,363 vs 689,629, H1 2024 1,766,191 vs 1,718,759, 9M 2023 2,921,723 vs 2,867,708; closing cash and net change are unchanged; (4) 2026 presentation splits marketing expense out of operating costs: Q1 2025 operating costs 1,625,213 vs 1,589,804 (gross profit 612,421 vs 647,830), H1 2025 3,512,811 vs 3,442,113; operating profit unchanged; (5) the unaudited year-end FY2025 interim filing (78b11862) and the audited FY2025 FS (3236f81f) differ in cash flow: CFO 3,256,845 vs 3,214,077, CFF 1,643,718 vs 1,686,487, CFI -5,639,192 vs -5,639,193; income statement, balance sheet, net change and closing cash 1,082,871 are identical; the audited document is the authoritative one. Revenue, total assets, equity and net profit agree across filings everywhere. Equity-accounted investees and NCI are consolidated as printed; no discontinued operations.

document_completeness.summary: Of the 16 filings read, all contain balance sheet, income statement, OCI, equity and cash flow statements on image-only pages. The inventory marks only 4 of them complete: it classes 9 as other_no_statements_found (Q1/H1/9M 2023, 2024, 2025 where applicable, Q1 2026, FY2025 unaudited), 2 as partial, 1 as scanned_unreadable (9M 2024) and gives 4 annual files the publication-year label (FY2022 labelled 2023, FY2023 labelled 2024, FY2024 labelled 2025, FY2025 labelled 2026). Nine 2022 interim/year-end files are classed scanned_unreadable and by cover, index and KPMG report appear to be complete bilingual condensed FS (statement pages not read) (cover, index and KPMG report seen; each period exists in Arabic and English). The inventory also mislabels the Arabic FY2025 press release as 2026|9M. Duplicates: nearly every period exists in Arabic and English; the English FY2025 'FY' period has TWO different documents (unaudited year-end interim 78b11862 and audited 3236f81f) whose cash flows differ. Not assessed for the 2008-2021 files.
